languages.notes: Практический полевой профиль: перечислены языки, с которыми путешественник реально столкнётся в регионе; это не полный этнолингвистический перечень.

climate.summary: Cooler highland climate than the lowlands; inland Sarawak stays wet year-round, with somewhat less rain June–August. Weather directly affects small-aircraft and logging-road access.

geography.summary: Kelabit Highlands — серия высокогорных долин северо-восточного Sarawak, в основном свыше 1,000 м, окружённых лесными вершинами; Bario is the principal settlement/gateway.

relief.summary: Sarawak Tourism describes valleys a little above 1,000 m, with surrounding peaks above 2,400 m in parts of the highlands.

health.note: This is state-level background only; highland/vector exposure is not inferred from it.

ethnography.kelabit: Bario is a Kelabit territory with dispersed villages/longhouses, rice cultivation and distinctive highland food traditions.

transport.air: Sarawak Tourism Board: Miri–Bario Twin Otter flight is about 45 minutes.
transport.road: 4WD via logging roads from Miri can take roughly 10–14 hours depending on road condition and weather.
